Dear [Miss Manning](../persons.html#949)

[Miss Walter](../persons.html#1462) and I have much enjoyed reading [Miss Lawrence](../persons.html#2434)s' letter all the more as last Sunday evening [Mr Du Boulay](../persons.html#446) kindly came and talked to the parish about Madagascar.[^1]

If you will let me know in time, I will send you [the Daisy Chain](../books.html#24), [Trial](../books.html#53) and [Pillars of the House](../books.html#109)to send to her.  I am very glad to have the pleasure of doing so

with many thanks

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: James du Boulay was a schoolmaster at Winchester College; he was married to a sister of the Bishop of Madagascar.

The book dealer who sold the letter read it as \'Mrs du Boulay\', but it looks to me like Mr.

Either is possible.
